proposed.explanation: Direction is determined by fixture placement and angle. Color temperature of light, not saturation of finishes, affects mood. Intensity (brightness) is separate from color temperature. Color temperature fundamentally affects mood: warm light (2700K) feels intimate and relaxing; cool light (5000K) feels alert and clinical. Contemporary design uses warmer light in evenings, cooler light daytime to support circadian rhythms.
